text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PD page fired: INC-2026-9843 — eu-inference-kv-cache high p95 latency (threshold 500ms)

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered by rule: eu-kv-cache-latency > 500ms for 3m. Escalation policy: inference-eu-primary.

Ben (oncall): Acked and taking. I'm jumping on the bridge. Can someone post the rough customer impact?

Alice (SRE): On it. Quick snapshot: p95 = 1.2s, p50 = 120ms. Error rate slightly elevated (5xx ~0.4% from baseline 0.05%). Traffic is normal, looks like backend KV ops are queuing.

Clara (eng-runtime): Notified — recent deploy of kv-cache tuning went out ~09:10 UTC (config: batch_window=8ms -> 20ms). Could be causing backpressure at certain seq lengths.

David (support): I've got two tickets flagged as "generation timeout" from EU customers, one flagged P1 (payments flow). Pinged customer success.

Ben (oncall): Good context. Plan: 1) revert the kv-cache tuning to previous config (fast path) 2) scale replica set in eu region 3) enable fallback routing to smaller model variant for affected tenants. Who can execute 1 and 2?

Clara (eng-runtime): I can do the revert. Pushing a rollback to kv-cache config now.

Alice (SRE): I'll scale the deployment and watch the pod restarts/latency. Scaling up 3 -> 9 now. Command: ```kubectl -n inference scale deploy/kv-cache-eu --replicas=9```

Ben (oncall): Executing step 3: adding temporary routing rule to prefer model-quant-small for customers impacted by high latency. Patch applied to routing layer.

pagerbot: Action log: rollback config started by Clara at 1766667789, scaling initiated by Alice at 1766667791.

Clara (eng-runtime): Rollback applied — config back to batch_window=8ms. Restarting service to pick up previous binary. ```kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/kv-cache-eu```

Alice (SRE): Pods are coming up. Initial metrics show p95 dropping from 1.2s -> 700ms and trending down. Error rate decreasing.

Ben (oncall): Noted. Can support confirm tickets for the P1 customer were escalated?

David (support): CS engaged the P1 and provided mitigation steps. They reported temporary slow responses but no data loss. They asked for ETA — told them we'll have an update in 15m.

Clara (eng-runtime): Side note: we saw a spike in long sequence KV hits correlated with a specific client ID. I am capturing traces to follow up after stabilization.

Ben (oncall): Good. Alice — keep an eye for any flapping. If p95 stays >600ms after 10 more minutes we'll consider a temporary traffic-shift to us-region.

Alice (SRE): Copy. Adding a dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/kvcache/eu-latency?from=-15m

pagerbot: Update: p95 = 430ms at 1766667812, error rate 0.07%.

Ben (oncall): Nice. I'm going to notify product + legal for the P1 escalation (customer-facing). @David please add a short summary to the incident ticket with timeline/impact.

David (support): Will update ticket INC-2026-9843 with timeline, affected tenants, actions taken.

Clara (eng-runtime): Traces captured for the suspect client. I'll create a follow-up ticket for perf regression analysis and include the trace ids.

Ben (oncall): Rolling status check — who wants ownership for the postmortem/ RCA? Prefer someone from runtime + SRE.

Alice (SRE): I'll co-author the RCA. Clara — can you take the runtime writeup?

Clara (eng-runtime): Yep, I'll draft the runtime section.

Ben (oncall): Handoff — my shift ends in ~40m. Handing to Eli (oncall-eu-night) for monitoring and any follow-ups. Eli, plz watch latency and customer comms.

Eli (oncall-eu-night): Taking handoff. Confirmed p95 430ms, scaling stable. I have contact with CS on standby.

Ben (oncall): Thanks. Final customer impact note: one P1 saw timeouts but no lost data, ~2 other tenants had elevated latencies. Estimated customer minutes affected: ~25-40 min window.

David (support): Added to ticket: "P1: temporary timeouts (no data loss). Actions: rollback config, scale replicas, routing fallback applied."

pagerbot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. PD incident will remain open for RCA.

Ben (oncall): Closing real-time bridge. Leaving incident open for postmortem. If anything regresses, re-open this thread or page the escalation policy. :thumbsup:

Eli (oncall-eu-night): Acknowledged. I'll post a short postmortem draft tomorrow morning and ping the CS contact once finalized.

Clara (eng-runtime): Captured trace ids and perf samples in follow-up ticket INC-2026-9843-FU.

Alice (SRE): Dropping a quick command note for the RCA: ```kubectl get events -n inference --field-selector involvedObject.name=kv-cache-eu --since=1h```

pagerbot: Log: bridge closed at 1766667823.

Ben (oncall): Thanks team. Great quick work.

David (support): Thx. I'll loop back with CS and affected customers with the incident summary.

Clara (eng-runtime): Thanks all. I'll link the PR that changed batch_window so we can discuss rollout guards.

Eli (oncall-eu-night): Signing off monitoring handoff.
